text: There are an awful lot of stars in our universe and our star, our sun, has a lot of planets
around it and it would seem highly egotistical, I think, that if we thought that we were the
only planet in the entire universe that had life on it.
No matter how far you can see when you're looking into the universe, you just aren't
looking at the end of it.
And it doesn't make any difference whether you're doing it with your naked eye, with
we're the biggest thing that we have here on Earth.
We just can't see to the end of it.
And I can't imagine myself that there aren't environments
throughout that entire universe that are in some way similar to ours.
